7 September 2026
Director/PDMR Shareholding

Currys plc (the 'Company') announces that Elaine Bucknor, Non-Executive Director, purchased 1,000 ordinary shares of 0.1p each in the Company at a price of 152.2p per share on 28 August 2026.

This announcement is made in accordance with the requirements of Article 19 of the EU Market Abuse Regulation 596/2014 (as incorporated into UK domestic law by the European Union (Withdrawal) Act 2018).
